description: This file defines a PHP class for validating IPv4 addresses within the HTMLPurifier library's attribute validation framework. It includes a regex for matching IPv4 addresses and a method to validate given IP addresses against this regex.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI_IPv4
classes.description: A class for validating IPv4 addresses within the HTMLPurifier framework.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates an input IP address string against the IPv4 regex pattern and returns the IP if valid, or false otherwise.

methods.name: _loadRegex
methods.description: Lazy loads the IPv4 regex pattern into the class property to avoid unnecessary computation until validation is needed.
